predictions.guard_summary: LoginRequiredMixin is applied to the view, ensuring that only authenticated users can access this functionality. The get_object method uses get_queryset() to retrieve all user sessions and excludes the current session using exclude(session_key=self.request.session.session_key). predictions.risk_pattern: The view allows authenticated users to delete all other active sessions except their own.
